title: NEW FINDING OF THREE KINDS OF GLASSY STATE POR CYCLOHEXENE AS A SINGLE COMPOUND
abstract: Abstract                Three kinds of glassy state of cyclohexene were discovered. Two of them are of crystalline phase, and were prepared in situ in calorimeter cell by different thermal treatments. These Tg values were 81 K (crystal-I) and 83 K (crystal-II), respectively. The glassy liquid was also prepared by vapor condensation method, its Tg being 78 K (DTA-value).
